answer: Temporary Compute Lock. Each new agent identity must run a randomized 30-minute workload on scarce shared hardware before earning. The cluster paints a unique pigment into timing noise, so operators can't fake completion across wallets. Identities share a per-operator haven quota: exceeding it freezes all their agents at once. On a cold tundra of new registrations, the cost is real CPU-hours plus total fleet downtime—not a token deposit.
